data.text: Count me in for 10 tons, John. I learned to fish here with my family, and I want the lake to keep supporting our village for years to come. Luke, thank you for offering to sit out, but there’s room for you to earn a fair share without reducing next month’s stock. Let’s keep the combined catch at 50 tons and check the reports together afterward. Emma, would you join us? Luke, would you accept 10 tons rather than the trial?
